$Comment: The Activity ledger: the tall panel of whatever a player is in the middle of. A row appears
the moment a mod reports a value moved and goes away when it stops; nothing is authored for
one to show up. Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudRows/ is where you retune a single row, and this
file is the panel they all sit on.
Placement names the spot the panel sits at, one of the files under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudSpots/ (Top_Left is shipped for this panel). That file carries the
corner, the offsets, how the rows spread there and the least height the panel draws at. To
nudge it without changing the spot, add a Position block here with only the leaves you want
different, or a Columns, RowsPerColumn, Gap, Cutout, MinHeight or Color leaf; anything you
leave out keeps the spot's own value. A player may pick another offered spot for themselves
in the HUD settings, and their pick replaces the whole group.
MaxVisible is unstated, so every slot the panel has is available; state a smaller number to
keep it short, and the most recently moved rows are the ones you see. RepaintMs is how often
the panel redraws at most: a movement redraws immediately when the last redraw is already that
old, and one arriving sooner is drawn at the window's end, so a number on screen is never left
waiting on a later movement to bring it up to date. Lower is livelier and costs more network
traffic. LabelKey names the panel in the HUD settings, and Order is where it is listed there:
lower numbers first, so the World bars (Order 10) come before this panel (Order 20), with room
between them for a panel of your own. Order is only the listing; it does not change which
panel draws over the other where two overlap on screen.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Activity_Ledger' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-panels.json with only the leaves you want different, or use the
Server tab of the HUD settings, which writes that file for you. Set Enabled to false there to
switch this whole panel off for everyone.
